question: What preliminary actions must be taken toward the target using the noose seed-syllable?
premises: The target must be firmly bound.
The noose seed-syllable is the instrument.
inference: Having gone to the target, one should firmly bind them using the noose seed-syllable.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the noose seed-syllable is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O beautiful one, having gone to the target, bind them firmly with the noose seed-syllable.
